capabilities: Opens the current note or one heading section full-screen at 18–72px
Renders inline readings like 参加(さんか) as furigana above the kanji
Shows on/kun readings, meanings, stroke count, grade and JLPT level on kanji hover
Lists words in the note that contain the hovered kanji
Detects vocabulary tables and grammar headings as word sources
disambiguation: Not just a font-size magnifier: it also renders inline readings as furigana ruby and shows an offline KANJIDIC2 popup with readings, meanings and words from the note.
extras: The ~3,000-kanji KANJIDIC2 dictionary is embedded in main.js, so it works offline with nothing extra to download; the listing says 'after approval', so it may not be in the Community Plugins directory yet.
problem: Obsidian renders kanji at fixed small sizes and has no furigana or built-in kanji dictionary, so Japanese study notes are hard to read and look up.
summary: Full-screen zoom viewer for Japanese study notes that enlarges kanji up to 72px, renders inline furigana and shows hover lookups with readings and meanings.
